title: Exclusive: upliance.ai In Talks To Raise Up To $4 Mn For R&D, Global Expansion
script:
Upliance.ai is in advanced talks to raise up to four million dollars in fresh funding.
This investment round translates to roughly twenty eight to thirty seven crore rupees.
The direct to consumer home appliance startup builds smart cooking devices powered by AI.
The team plans to channel the new capital directly into research and development.
Beyond product engineering, the company aims to fuel an aggressive global expansion strategy.
Would you put an AI assistant on your kitchen counter?

editor.one_line: Strong script and numbers, but terrible visual recycling destroys the reel.
visual_notes: line 1: Repeated static image starts immediately and sets a dull tone.
line 2: Holds the exact same company/founders photo for too long across multiple lines.
line 3: Zero visual change matching smart cooking devices; just shows the old photo again.
line 4: Switches to plain text placeholders instead of dynamic R&D or engineering visuals.
line 5: Reuses plain text cards again for global expansion instead of map or market graphics.
